Shop

The cat gets hungry over time and you lose pets each time hunger drops. Buy snacks to store them in your Inventory, then feed the cat when it is hungry. Drop it anywhere else and you get refunded.

Food you buy is stored here and stacks. Tap one to take it out, then drag it onto the cat.

Your inventory is empty. Buy food in the Food tab.

Rebirth resets your pets, helpers, perks and food. Each star adds 25% to every pet, forever, but makes every future star cost double the pets.
